summary: Iteration 8 tested: Statistik Mapel (GET /api/analytics/subjects) and Filter Peringkat Siswa (category_id on /api/leaderboard/me), plus UI on /admin (subject-stats-chart) and /peringkat (student-subject-filter). issues: Recharts logs repeated 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warnings on initial mount (ResponsiveContainer measuring before layout). Chart still renders correctly after layout settles. Consider giving the ResponsiveContainer an explicit min-height or aspect ratio to silence warnings.

critical_code_review_comments: analytics/subjects: N is small so per-attempt in-memory grouping is fine, but note it loads up to 20k attempts each call - if attempts grow large consider a MongoDB $group aggregation.
compute_class_leaderboard performs one attempts.find per student (N+1 queries). Acceptable for small classes but should be batched via aggregation for scalability.
